reference.source_note_ocr: National Safety Council 2016. Data for Fire, Drowning, and Poison (solid or liquid) are aggre- gated over 1903-1998 and 1999-2014 datasets. For 1999-2014, data for Poison (solid or liquid) include poisonings by gas or vapor. Data for Falls extend only to 1992 because of reporting artifacts in subse- quent years (see note 50 for details).
